notes:
## Added

- **Attachment tray:** image attachments now stage in a dedicated tray in the composer instead of inline chips, giving clearer previews and consistent handling across drops, pastes, and restored drafts.
- **Vision-aware messaging:** when the selected chat model lacks vision support, native image parts are dropped from the request (avoiding provider errors) while image file paths stay in the text body so describe/edit tools can still reference them.

## Changed

- **Subagent model handling:** spawned agents and resumed subagents now validate their requested model against the provider's catalog and fall back to the root model when a definition references an unknown alias (e.g. `sonnet`/`opus`), preventing whole child-turn failures.
- **Composer and chat UX:** attachment rendering, diff review, tool cards, conversation menu, and Markdown/shell styling are clearer and more resilient.
